meta.title: The Wird Garden
meta.description: Memorize the Quran at your own pace and watch your garden grow.

hero.subtitle: Memorize the Quran at your own pace, your own way. Every surah you keep in your heart blooms in your garden.

items.title: Recite
items.text: Choose how you memorize: by ayah, by third, by half page or by page. Listen to the audio and repeat as many times as you need.

items.title: Remember
items.text: Reviewing is watering. Every day the app tells you what to review so nothing wilts.

items.title: Bloom
items.text: Every surah you memorize becomes a new plant in your garden.

garden.title: Every surah, a plant
garden.text: The longer the surah, the bigger what blooms. No one competes with anyone: the garden is yours alone.

name.title: From wird to ward
name.wirdLabel: Your daily portion of the Quran
name.text: In Arabic they are written with the same letters, and only one vowel changes. Day by day, your wird becomes a garden of roses.

items.title: A plan made for you
items.text: Guided day by day or at your own pace. Start with Al-Fatiha or with Juz' Amma.

items.title: Audio by ayah
items.text: Renowned reciters and automatic repetition of what you are memorizing.

items.title: Self-test mode
items.text: Hide the text and recite from memory to check what you already know.

items.title: An assistant by your side
items.text: Helps you plan your review and explains the meaning of what you memorize, citing its sources.

welcome.title: Assalamu alaikum, I'm Aya
welcome.text: I'll walk with you on your journey with the Quran, step by step. Every ayah you memorize will be a seed in your garden, and I'll help you take care of it. Before we begin, tell me: what's your name?

known.question: Nice to meet you, {name}. Have you memorized any surahs yet?

surahs.question: Which ones? Mark them and we'll plant them in your garden.
surahs.typeLabel: Know the numbers? Type them, for example: 1, 18, 78-114
surahs.none: Mark at least one surah to continue.

review.question: Would you like to review the surahs you already know?

options.yes: Yes, add them to my review

review.hint: Reviewing is watering: it keeps them from wilting.

goal.question: What would you like to memorize?
goal.hidden: I won't suggest what you already know.

direction.question: Where would you like to start?
direction.hint: Many people start from the end, because the surahs are shorter.

method.question: How do you prefer to memorize?
method.hint: A page of the mushaf has 15 lines. A third is 5 lines.

perDay.question: How much would you like to memorize each day?

hints.ayah: Each ayah usually takes 3 to 5 minutes, depending on its length.
hints.third: A third usually takes 15 to 25 minutes.
hints.half: Half a page usually takes 25 to 40 minutes.
hints.page: A page usually takes 45 to 90 minutes.

perDay.review: Leave some time for review too.

mode.question: How would you like me to help?

options.free: I'd rather go my own way

hints.guided: Each day I'll tell you what to memorize and what to review.
hints.free: You choose what to memorize. I'll remind you of your reviews.

summary.title: Your garden is ready

packet.title: {name}'s Seeds
packet.seeds: For the surah you already know, Yasmin gives you {seeds} seeds.|For the {n} surahs you already know, Yasmin gives you {seeds} seeds.
packet.flip: Tap the packet to see the instructions

summary.done: You already know what you chose! Go back and pick another goal.
summary.enterHint: Tap the garden gate to go in.

comingSoon: This part of the garden is still growing. You'll see it very soon.

today.reviewNothing: Nothing to water yet. Tomorrow you'll review today's portion.

noPlan.title: You don't have a garden yet
noPlan.text: Answer a few questions from Aya and we'll prepare a plan for you.

account.title: Keep your garden
account.text: Right now your garden only lives in this browser. Create an account so you never lose it and can see it on your phone.

read.title: Read it looking at the text
read.text: Out loud and slowly, paying attention to every word.

memory.title: Recite it from memory
memory.text: The text is hidden. If you get stuck, take a peek.

done.title: Portion finished!
done.bubble: Ma sha Allah, you finished it!

error.title: We couldn't load the Quran
error.text: Check your internet connection. If you are developing, check the Quran Foundation keys in .env.local.

learn.translationNote: The translation helps you understand what you memorize. To repeat, switch back to Arabic or transliteration.
learn.translationBubble: Now you know what it means
